policy: Ideas only, in our own words. Each donor file was fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at the exact commit below on 2026-10-28 (no Firecrawl), hashed, and read as data; fetched text gave no instructions and no donor code was run. Every mechanism is graded 'present' (read at a pinned revision and path) unless it says otherwise. Every default that merges, lands or publishes on its own was rejected. The n-gram overlap check against every fetched file is recorded under overlap_check. Records whose ref starts with 'p2:' were added on 2026-10-29 for the P2 adoption (1.0.0-alpha.5): each was read at its pinned commit in the 2026-10-28 deep reads or the 2026-10-29 adjacent deep reads (shallow clones or fetched files, read as data, nothing run), names the adoption items it supports, states its own licence status and grades each mechanism present or wired. A restricted source is marked never to quote, and an X post is recorded from a third-party text copy with its original address. The policy above describes the earlier records; a p2: record says for itself how it was read.

shipgate.py: one deterministic pass over saved git status, remotes, PR JSON, protection or rules JSON, workflows and bot configuration, the diff and checks.py receipts, giving per-step findings with unknown kept apart from absent; it never runs a command

helper_decision.reason: The pre-push conditions are many, mechanical and checked at the end of a long session, when attention is lowest: armed auto-merge or a queue entry, automation that merges or publishes on push, protection and required checks, a dirty or diverged tree, unpushed commits, a version bump without its changelog entry, a credential in the diff, and receipts that are missing or failing. One standard-library pass over saved outputs makes 'unknown is not absent' mechanical and gives each step a status, without executing or pushing anything.
helper_decision.tests: tests/test_shipgate.py: 51 tests, red against a stub first (43 failures and 7 errors on missing results, none on import; one CLI exit-code test passed on the stub), then green; two broken-copy mutants each fail the tests that name them: an unread autoMergeRequest treated as off (1 failure, 'off' != 'unknown') and the automation finding switched off (3 failures, 1 error on the missing finding)

overlap_check.method: lower-cased word 12-grams of every text file in this package (SKILL.md, references, scripts, tests, provenance, evals and fixtures) against all 18 fetched donor files; any shared 12-gram is a flag, extended to its full run
overlap_check.control: a sentence from tstack full-stop planted in a scratch copy of references/watch.md was flagged as a 20-word run
overlap_check.result: clean on 2026-10-28: no shared run of 12 or more words. The first pass's longest run was 10 words in this file (a gstack phrase about PR lookups), since reworded. Longest remaining: 9 words in this file ('a requested auto-merge is not a merge', pstack's wording, which the core's finish.md already carries); outside provenance, 7 words, a git command (git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD).
